question: According to the Census of India 2011, what is the sex ratio of Daman and Diu?
solution:
The correct answer is **__618__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daman and Diu** is a **union territory** in India, located on the **west coast**.
 
• According to the **2011 census**, the** total population** of Daman and Diu was **242,911**.
 
• The** population density** was** 2,191 people/km²**.
 
• The** sex ratio** was** 618** females for every 1,000 males.
 
• The** literacy rate** in Daman and Diu was **87.1%**, with a higher literacy rate among males compared to females.
 
• The** majority of the population** in Daman and Diu practiced **Hinduism**, followed by **Christianity and Islam**.
 
• The **main languages** spoken in Daman and Diu are **Gujarati, Hindi, **and **English**.
 
• The union territory has a** total area** of **112 km²**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Census 2011 Important points:**

 
 
• **​**The Census 2011 was conducted in India from** February 9 to 28, 2011**
 
• It was the **15th Census of Indi**a and the** 7th since independence**
 
• The** total population** of India in 2011 was **1,210,854,977**
 
• The **sex ratio** in India was** 940** females for every 1,000 males
 
• The** literacy rate** in India was **74.04%**, with **male literacy** at **82.14%** and **female literacy** at** 65.46%**
 
• The **population density** of India was **382** persons per square kilometer
 
• The state of **Uttar Pradesh** had the** highest population**, while **Lakshadweep** had the **lowest population**
 
• The state of **Kerala** had the **highest literacy rate**, while **Bihar** had the** lowest**
 
• The Census also collected data on various **socio-economic indicators** such as** housing, employment, **and **household amenities**
 
• The data from Census 2011 is used for **policy-making, resource allocation,** and **planning** at both **national and state levels.**
